channel.title: frontier-wire
channel.description: An openly automated bilingual news wire (RU+EN): AI, tech, science, world, culture, economy.

item.title: За два дня вышли пять новых ИИ-моделей — и это больше похоже на войну цен, чем на прорыв / Five new AI models landed in two days — this looks like a price war, not a breakthrough
item.description: Grok 4.7, MiMo v2.6, Claude Opus 5.5, and two GPT-6 models — Sol and Luna — arrived almost back to back. (source: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/22/opus-and-sol-and-luna/)

item.title: Тысячи людей, депортированных из США, оказались в странах, о существовании которых не знали / Thousands deported from the US ended up in countries they didn't know existed
item.description: The Guardian has published an investigation into the Trump administration's secret deportation deals with dozens of countries. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/sep/21/trump-deportation-deals)

item.title: Евросоюз покупает у Китая втрое больше, чем Китай — у Евросоюза / The EU buys three times more from China than China buys from the EU
item.description: A new study ahead of the Xi Jinping–Trump summit shows the EU's trade deficit with China running above €1bn a day. (source: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/sep/22/eu-imports-china-exports-trade-deficit-xi-jinping-donald-trump)

item.title: Половина нашего генома состоит из вирусоподобных «прыгающих генов» — и это не мусор / Half our genome is made of virus-like "jumping genes" — and it's not junk
item.description: Transposons — DNA snippets that can copy and move themselves — turn out to be evolutionary partners, not parasites. (source: https://www.quantamagazine.org/how-virus-like-jumping-genes-became-our-partners-in-evolution-20260921/)

item.title: Может, дерматологи ошибаются насчёт солнца? Новая книга спорит с официальным консенсусом / Are dermatologists wrong about the sun? A new book pushes back on the official consensus
item.description: Rowan Jacobsen's "In Defense of Sunlight" argues sunlight has been unfairly cast as purely dangerous. (source: https://undark.org/2026/08/28/book-review-in-defense-of-sunlight/)

item.title: Трамп подписал «феноменальную» сделку по безопасности с Гренландией и Данией / Trump signs a "tremendous" security deal with Greenland and Denmark
item.description: The deal was struck on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, after Trump repeatedly said the US should own the Arctic island. (source: https://www.dw.com/en/trump-signs-tremendous-greenland-security-deal/a-79381148?maca=en-rss-en-all-1573-rdf)

item.title: Rabbit, создатель провального гаджета R1, выпускает ИИ-агента без самого гаджета / Rabbit, maker of the underwhelming R1 gadget, ships an AI agent without the gadget
item.description: The new "agentic operating system" OS3 runs in the cloud but carries out actions locally across platforms. (source: https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/999094/rabbit-ai-agent-os3)

item.title: Три телесети подали в суд на Белый дом — и пресс-пул отказался его освещать / Three US networks sue the White House — and the press pool refuses to cover it
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico are suing over their exclusion from the White House, and reporters refused to cover Trump's trip in protest. (source: https://www.pbs.org/newshour/show/press-pool-declines-to-cover-trump-in-protest-of-his-ban-on-news-outlets)

item.title: Власти канадской провинции подали в суд на OpenAI — из-за роли ChatGPT в школьной стрельбе / A Canadian province sues OpenAI over ChatGPT's role in a school shooting
item.description: British Columbia claims the company ignored signs of a deadly threat and is demanding an overhaul of ChatGPT's safety systems. (source: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/9/22/canadas-bc-sues-openai-over-chatgpt-role-in-tumbler-ridge-school-shooting?traffic_source=rss)

item.title: У ИИ-ассистента Muse от Meta нашли серьёзную уязвимость нулевого дня / Meta's AI assistant Muse has a serious zero-day vulnerability
item.description: A ClickFix-style attack is just one way to fully hijack an agent with sweeping access privileges. (source: https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/09/muse-metas-extraordinarily-privileged-ai-assistant-has-a-serious-0-day/)

item.title: Учёные создали нитевидный имплант для мозга, который делает сразу три вещи / Scientists built a needle-thin brain implant that does three jobs at once
item.description: A single flexible fiber implant can record neural activity, deliver drugs, and stimulate multiple brain regions at once. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260920222416.htm)

item.title: Чёрные дыры любого размера запускают джеты по одному и тому же правилу / Black holes of every size follow the same rule when launching jets
item.description: Supermassive black holes fire a jet soon after tearing apart a star — then unexpectedly switch it back on hundreds or thousands of days later. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260920222358.htm)

item.title: Страх перед ростом ставок и потерей работы обвалил доверие потребителей в Британии / Fear of rate hikes and job losses tanks UK consumer confidence

item.title: Наука без озарений: новая книга разрушает миф об «эврике» / Science without eureka moments: a new book debunks the myth
item.description: In "Lost in Curiosity," Roberta Kwok portrays science not as a string of flashes of insight but as messy, everyday work. (source: https://undark.org/2026/09/04/book-review-lost-in-curiosity/)

item.title: Британия впервые предъявила обвинения по делу о геноциде в Руанде 1994 года / The UK brings its first-ever charges over the 1994 Rwanda genocide
item.description: A 65-year-old man, formerly known as Dr Vincent Bajinya, faces seven charges — more than three decades after the massacres. (source: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr2092216nywo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)

item.title: Paramount пошла на уступки, чтобы спасти сделку с Warner Bros. Discovery на $111 млрд / Paramount makes concessions to save its $111 billion Warner Bros. Discovery deal
item.description: Paramount's owners struck a deal with 12 Democratic state attorneys general to defuse a lawsuit that threatened its bid for its larger Hollywood rival. (source: https://www.npr.org/2026/09/21/nx-s1-5974909/paramount-warner-bros-lawsuit)

item.title: NASA включило 300-мегапиксельную камеру телескопа «Роман» / NASA powers up the Roman Space Telescope's 300-megapixel camera
item.description: The infrared camera and planet-hunting coronagraph are working as expected, bringing the telescope a step closer to starting science operations. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260921081058.htm)

item.title: Перерезанный строителями кабель нарушил работу сотен рейсов по всей Америке / A cable severed by construction crews disrupted hundreds of US flights

item.title: Уход США из программ помощи бьёт по здравоохранению Африки, предупреждает доклад / US withdrawal from aid programs is straining healthcare across Africa, report warns

item.description: At Oak Ridge National Laboratory, polyethylene from shopping bags and cutting boards is being turned into fuel using cheap aluminum-based molten salts. (source: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/09/260920222405.htm)
